title: Site formation processes and site use in the Late Pleistocene and Early Holocene: micromorphology and FTIR analysis at the cave sites of Xianrendong and Yuchanyan
lineage: Dissertation includes detailed original geoarchaeological observations. Arpin coauthored Wu et al. 2012. The techniques describe the same excavation research and earlier ceramic assemblage reports.

passages.note: The earliest West Area sherds in layers 3C1B and 3C1A were described as slab-joined and sometimes stripe-marked. Later 3B2 and above has examples with coiling and paddle impressions. Same site sequence does not establish continuous occupation or origin of the later technique.
